content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT(ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT(ISM) Dhanbad Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 31 August 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a M.E./M.Tech/ M.S/ Integrated M.Tech or B.E/B.Tech in specific disciplines, or an M.Sc./M.Sc.Tech degree. Additionally, they must have qualified the GATE/CSIR-UGC NET examination.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- plus applicable House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow position announced in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad (IIT(ISM) Dhanbad).

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is SRDP 1352 G.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow is on a contractual basis.
